title: Karona Falls and Jeska Ascends
summary: The Mirari sword breaks Karona apart; Akroma and Zagorka die while Jeska becomes a planeswalker.
narrative: Sash and Waistcoat betrayed Karona and stabbed her with the Mirari sword, separating the three beings whose fusion had created the false god.
Akroma and Zagorka died, but Jeska survived and her planeswalker spark ignited. Karn became her mentor, linking the Otarian saga to later events on Dominaria.
